extraManifests.description: Additional manifests to deploy. Strings are rendered with `tpl`.
extraManifests.title: extraManifests

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override `"mongodb-community.fullname"`. It is the name of the MongoDBCommunity resource and of its replica set.
fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

mongodb.description:
Spec of the MongoDBCommunity resource, rendered as is. All fields of the
[CRD](https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes/blob/master/helm_chart/crds/mongodbcommunity.mongodb.com_mongodbcommunity.yaml) are supported,
see the [documentation](https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes/tree/master/docs/mongodbcommunity) of the operator.

members.description: Number of members of the replica set
members.title: members

modes.description: Authentication mechanisms. `SCRAM` enables SCRAM-SHA-256 and SCRAM-SHA-1, `X509` requires TLS.
modes.title: modes

type.description: Type of the deployment. MongoDB Community only supports replica sets.
type.title: type

users.description: Users of the database. If a user has no `passwordSecretRef`, the chart generates a password and stores it in the Secret `<fullname>-<name>-password` (key `password`). `scramCredentialsSecretName` defaults to `<fullname>-<name>`.
users.title: users

version.description: MongoDB version. The operator requires the exact version and runs the image `quay.io/mongodb/mongodb-community-server:<version>-ubi8`.
version.title: version

mongodb.title: mongodb

nameOverride.description: Provide a name in place of `mongodb-community`
nameOverride.title: nameOverride

enabled.description: Deploy MongoDB Search (MongoDBSearch resource) for full-text and vector search. Adds the user `search-sync-source` used by the search nodes to the replica set.
enabled.title: enabled

spec.description: Spec of the MongoDBSearch resource, rendered as is. See the [CRD](https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-kubernetes/blob/master/helm_chart/crds/mongodb.com_mongodbsearch.yaml) for all options.
spec.title: spec

create.description: Create the ServiceAccount, Role and RoleBinding for the database pods, which need access to their Secrets and Pods
create.title: create

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. If empty, `<fullname>-database` is used if `serviceAccount.create` is true, otherwise the operator's default `mongodb-kubernetes-appdb`.
name.title: name

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor for the Prometheus Operator. Requires `mongodb.prometheus` to be configured.
enabled.title: enabled

interval.description: Interval at which metrics are scraped
interval.title: interval

labels.description: Additional labels of the ServiceMonitor, e.g. to match the `serviceMonitorSelector` of Prometheus
labels.title: labels

tlsConfig.description: TLS configuration of the scrapes, used if `mongodb.prometheus.tlsSecretKeyRef` is set
tlsConfig.title: tlsConfig
